shortDescription: A senior executive at Radiant World’s China office has quit as the iron ore trader faces pressure over concerns it provided falsified documents to banks, according to Bloomberg.Sources familiar with the matter said the departure comes amid those concerns.

title: Radiant World China Trader Quits Amid Document Concerns
